inc_bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: kv_cache_memory_exceeded on hosted-runtime-prod-eu-west-1; 6 nodes reporting OOM-like kernel kills, continuous-batching spike detected

alex.sre: seeing it. spike started ~3412345676. high tail latency & 502s for some customers.

maria.ops: paging oncall now — @natalie-oncall you're up for hosted runtime?

natalie-oncall: I'm here. what's the blast radius?

alex.sre: ~5% of hosted traffic routed to this cluster; but errors concentrated on long-prompt sessions ( > 50k tokens ). KV map growth runaway when prefetch tries to fill long context windows.

taylor.runtime: logs show continuous-batching holding very large live KV windows in memory. prefetch controller didn't cap per-session keys because of regression in batching_policy v2.1.3 -> v2.1.4.

sam.eng: confirmed regression in PR #8924 — batch_size_override introduced an interaction where prefetch_delta wasn't bounded for streaming requests.

jin-support: multiple customers reporting model truncation or 502s. ticket count rising. CS alerted customers with potential degraded experience.

emily-cs: customer A (finance-prod) saw 35% failed requests; customer B saw timeouts. both flagged for SLA risk. we're sending status updates.

alex.sre: immediate mitigation plan: (1) disable aggressive prefetch on hosted runtime (2) rollback batching_policy to v2.1.2 (3) apply per-session kv_cap=8k entries as hotpatch. want someone to run the commands.

maria.ops: I'll handle the rollout. prepping playbook.

alex.sre: commands to patch (run on control-plane):

```bash
# reduce prefetch window to prevent kvmap blowup
redwoodctl runtime config set hosted-runtime-prod-eu-west-1 \
  --batching_policy=stable:v2.1.2 \
  --kv_prefetch_enabled=false

# apply soft cap that will evict long session prefixes earlier
redwoodctl runtime config update-metadata --kv_per_session_cap=8192
```

maria.ops: starting rollback now, will use canary then global.

(opsbot): deploy started: rollout id roll-2026-03-15-341234 - canary 5% -> 20% -> 100%

alex.sre: while that's rolling, add emergency eviction threshold to the prefetch controller to protect nodes.

taylor.runtime: pushing hotpatch to controller: `eviction_threshold=0.85` to slow down growth. shipping in 30s.

sam.eng: creating temporary autoscale rule bump to absorb tail: increase spot spare capacity + start 4 cold nodes.

alex.sre: confirmed nodes spun up, memory headroom increased. canary shows error rate drop from 18% -> 6%.

emily-cs: telling affected customers we've applied mitigations; ETA for full recovery ~20-25 minutes.

jin-support: customers want root cause: is this a model issue or platform?

alex.sre: platform regression in batching policy + prefetch heuristics interacting with very long prompts that produce KV map growth beyond eviction rate. not model.

natalie-oncall: summary for postmortem: regression introduced in v2.1.4 via PR #8924 (batch_size_override). prefetch controller lacked per-session hard cap. hotpatch: rollback to v2.1.2 + kv_per_session_cap=8192 + eviction_threshold set.

maria.ops: deploy completed: roll-2026-03-15-341234 -> success: 100% after 18m. monitoring looks healthy.

alex.sre: memory usage across nodes trending down. no further OOM messages for 12m.

taylor.runtime: will push a permanent fix tomorrow: add defensive checks in prefetch to bound keys by token-count and add a backpressure signal into continuous-batching.

sam.eng: follow-up items assigned: rollback review, add integ tests for long-prompt experiments, add chaos test for kvmap growth.

emily-cs: customers updated; two priority customers requested permanent mitigation roadmap. I linked them to the incident doc.

jin-support: triage notes: affected sessions mostly used streaming + tool-calls with long-system prompts + user-provided context.

alex.sre: impact timeline:
- 3412345676: metric spike detected
- 3412345680: pager fired
- 3412345684: rollback started
- 3412345690: hotpatch eviction applied
- 3412345696: errors drop to baseline

natalie-oncall: closing notes: no persistent data loss. mitigation successful. we'll run full postmortem and attach perf graphs + query traces. assigning owners:
- RCA owner: taylor.runtime
- Fix PR owner: sam.eng
- CS comms: emily-cs
- Postmortem writeup: alex.sre

maria.ops: adding memory/kvmap alert thresholds and a synthetic long-prompt test to the alerting playbook.

(inc_bot): INCIDENT RESOLVED: kv_cache_memory_exceeded on hosted-runtime-prod-eu-west-1 - status: mitigated, severity: high, duration: 20m

alex.sre: thanks everyone. we'll circle up in the morning for the follow-up sync. :thumbsup:
